mentions.name: Murder Stones
mentions.description: This site catalogues murder stones — stone memorials placed where someone was killed, mostly 18th–19th century UK examples, some of which are lost. It aims to be a definitive, publicly editable archive by collating snippets and references into a CSV-to-SQLite pipeline that generates a static site hosted on Netlify, with a local Flask app for hand-editing the database and forcing rebuilds.
mentions.problem: There was no definitive list of murder stones and very little coverage on Wikipedia.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on cataloguing Murder Stones!

These were stone memorials placed where someone was killed, especially in the UK. Most of them are 18th-19th century. Some are lost.

After watching a YouTube video about it and finding there was no definitive list, I registered https://murder-stones.org on Friday night and fired up claude code.
mentions.author: jimnotgym
